Law Explanation:
Yes. Early in my career, on February 29, 2008, I entered into a mutual separation agreement with the Hannibal Central School District. At that time, I participated in social functions with colleagues outside of work hours where alcohol was present. The situation ultimately gave rise to personally damaging rumors that affected my ability to continue in the role. I accepted responsibility for the judgment involved and used the experience as an important point of reflection in my professional life. It reinforced for me the importance of maintaining clear professional boundaries and exercising sound judgment at all times as a school leader. Since that time, my career has reflected a sustained record of professionalism, reliability, and advancement.
Following Hannibal, I served successfully as Director of Operations and later Executive Director at Iglesia Education Centers. I was subsequently recommended and appointed to the Otselic Valley Central School District, where I progressed from Business Administrator Intern to Business Administrator and Director of Facilities, then to UPK-12 Principal, and ultimately to Superintendent of Schools. In July 2020, I began as Superintendent of Schools at the Sherburne-Earlville Central School District.
On February 23, 2026, I entered into a mutual separation agreement with the Sherburne-Earlville Central School District. In 2023, I executed a professional services agreement intended to support the district’s efforts to maximize transportation aid, an approach being utilized by other regional districts. My intent was to position the district to benefit from similar efficiencies and opportunities.
The concern of the current board centered on the fact that I did not obtain formal Board of Education approval prior to executing the agreement. I take full responsibility for that oversight in governance protocol. While the action was taken in good faith to support the district’s operational and financial interests, I recognize that strict adherence to established approval processes is essential. Importantly, the matter involved procedure, not intent, integrity, or misuse of resources, nor deemed illegal, and it has further reinforced my commitment to transparency, communication, and governance alignment in leadership decision-making.
Both experiences have strengthened my leadership and deepened my commitment to sound governance and collaborative board relations. Throughout my career, I have continued to be entrusted with increasing responsibility because of my performance and character. I welcome reference checks with Mr. Joseph Gilfus, Dr. Richard Hughes, Mr. Jeremy Foster, Mrs. Marcia Marshall, Mr. Brian Wood, and Mrs. Nancy Dingman, who can speak directly to my integrity, effectiveness, and professional growth as a school leader.

Despite all of the stress of Covid I still maintained a dynamic and engaging curriculum for the elementary students, and I helped launch a community reads program that was very successful. The students and staff were very happy with my job performance and were always very excited whenever I came to their classrooms.

Law Explanation: In 2000 I found my young son, at our home in my estranged husband's closet playing with his fathers gun that he found hidden high upon a bedroom closet shelf.  At that time my spouse was not living at the residence, but would not comply with my request to removal his firearm.  In my attempt to keep my son safe, I gave this firearm to a handyman in my neighborhood, who at the time, was well regarded by both myself and other neighbors.  In exchanged for the gun he offered me money for this firearm.  Very soon after this the handy man tragically took his life with this gun.  As a result, I found myself caught up within gun control laws.  I was naive about gun control laws but see the value and importance of laws in relation to firearms.  I now know being naive about gun control laws does not exempt me from compliance and the responsibility of my actions.  The family of the handyman wrote a letter to the court on my behalf expressing their belief and support that I had no way of knowing what their son would do with this firearm.  The court ordered me to pay a fine and as a result I was convicted of a class E Felony.  I was granted a Relief of Civil Liability, where I was still able to hold a license to practice Dental Hygiene in New York State.  The Office of Professional Discipline ruled that there would not be any further actions against me considering the circumstances around this tragic situation.

Law Explanation: My first misdemeanor was a driving offense from last fall.
Application Type Statuses: Coach - Not CompletedTeacher / Admin - Not Complete
Paid Teaching Explanation: Two years full-time plus five years substitute teaching
Tenure Explanation: In November of 2008, I was hired to teach physics at the School of Engineering and Manufacturing at Edison, after the previous teacher was assaulted by a student and fired for defending himself effectively.  At the end of the school year, I was let go, as was the standard policy for untenured teachers in the Rochester City School District. My Principal was pleased with my performance and provided me with a letter of reference.  She then asked me to return for the 2009-10 school year. I resigned at the end of that year because my school administration appeared to differ with me on principles of education, ethics, and social justice to such a degree that I felt my professional and personal security was at risk.  A consistent comment from the various observers of my teaching was that  my talents were being wasted, and considering the time I invested, the paucity of resources, and my ability to impact the educational culture at Edison, I had to acknowledge that teaching in that environment was a poor fit.
Licensing Plan: If accepted as a coach, I will promptly obtain all qualifications needed.  It is my understanding that NYS law provides for a non-certified coach a certain time period to obtain those required prerequisites.  Last summer I took the First Aid requirement.
Coaching Experience: I have coached both boys (wrestling) and girls (volleyball) as a volunteer, and have produced successful athletes- one winning a state championship in wrestling.  My best friend growing up was a professional racquetball player, and exposure to such athletes teaches the incredible amount of mental and physical conditioning required to succeed.  I have competed in two World Championships in my current sport, sailing- as sport that involves continual coaching (of the driver + trimmer) and intellect, as opposed to physical prowess.  I have won a North American Championship, and know those intrinsic qualities required to succeed.  As a lifelong student of military history and leadership, I bring a very direct manner of mechanics, technique, and mental preparation.  The legendary and incredibly accomplished coach in Honeoye Falls - Lima, Bernie Gardner, requests me as his substitute teacher ahead of other certified Physical Education teachers and coaches.  He knows what he's doing.  An interview should impress upon you the ethics I espouse in character development, the time and efficiency techniques I apply to skills proficiencies, and the philosophy in tactics and strategy that I will use to teach your student athletes how to be successful in life's endeavors.
